Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template etc. The order must be as given, meaning first reaction uses 20810, second uses 2895, third uses 1914397, fourth uses 1914398, fifth uses 1914399, sixth uses 74054. Likely each reaction applies to one of the molecules from previous step, maybe sequentially on one branch.
